content.p: Sell products that are out of stock or not released yet, with a normal PrestaShop checkout and any payment module.
In **Pre-Order**, search for a product, choose the payment, optional date, unit limit, customer groups and countries, then **Save**. The product can now be ordered while its stock is zero or below.
**Full payment:** the customer pays everything now. **Deposit:** a percentage or fixed amount now, the balance later. **Customer chooses:** any amount above your minimum.
The product page shows the Pre-order button, a countdown and what is due now. Pre-order and regular products must be ordered separately.

When stock is added, customers are emailed automatically; those with a balance get a secure payment link. The balance order has free shipping and does not reduce stock again. **Notify** sends the emails by hand.
Rules apply to all combinations of a product. Deposits appear as the order amount, so each payment has its own invoice. The **Demand** table shows customers, units and value per product.
